name: Enhanced Dash Augmentation Server
description: Project-aware Dash MCP augmentation for docset recommendation, search planning, result ranking, and coverage explanations
author: Josh (Fort Collins, CO)

tools.name: analyze_project_docs_context
tools.description: Analyze a project directory for docs-relevant language, framework, dependency, and manifest context

tools.name: recommend_dash_docsets
tools.description: Recommend Dash docsets and attach official identifiers from a supplied official snapshot

tools.name: plan_dash_searches
tools.description: Plan official Dash MCP search_documentation calls for a repo task

tools.name: rank_dash_results
tools.description: Rank official Dash MCP search results while preserving load_url values

tools.name: summarize_docset_coverage
tools.description: Compare official Dash-visible docsets with valid local cache docsets

tools.name: suggest_offline_docs_for_repo
tools.description: Suggest offline docs for a repository using project context and local cache metadata

tools.name: explain_missing_docsets
tools.description: Explain whether requested docsets are official, local-only, or missing

docsets_path.description: Dash root or docsets path. Usually leave unset unless Dash docsets live outside the default location.

official_dash_mcp.boundary: Official Dash MCP owns list_installed_docsets, search_documentation, enable_docset_fts, and load_documentation_page.
